title: Blynk Garden Node Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=blynk:garden
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(plant_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Blynk garden node events land each day and how many distinct plant values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Blynk garden node records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct plant values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It fairly how much Blynk garden node activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
